ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal pixel intensity distribution with a primary cluster of low-intensity pixels (black) occupying approximately 80% of the visible surface and a secondary high-intensity cluster (white) on the left lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity region localized on the distal half of the left lobe; the remainder of the fluke is primarily low-intensity with scattered high-intensity mottling along the central longitudinal axis and trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve fitted to the outer boundary of the left lobe; the right lobe shows a more acute convex sweep towards a pointed tip.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant pigmentation asymmetry characterized by a high-intensity white distal patch on the left lobe contrasted against a predominantly solid low-intensity black right lobe.
